title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.
Sathya, a young policeman, curses his luck when he gets posted in a control room. However, his life takes an unusual turn after the 100th call he overhears.

title: Hit List
desc: A mysterious masked figure kidnaps the family of a peaceful man, forcing him into a life of violence. He becomes an unwilling assassin, targeting the kidnapper's enemies as a part of his revenge plan.

title: Policegiri
desc: Tired of the rampant corruption fueled by Nagori Subramaniam, DCP Rudra takes a defiant stand. He launches a one-man crusade to take down the crime lord and dismantle his criminal syndicate.

title: International Rowdy
desc: Love invents a lethal drug and gives it to terrorist outfits, who use it to kill Indian officials in Kuala Lumpur. When RAW officers find a love emblem tattoo on his neck, they start investigating.

title: PT Sir
desc: To avoid problems, a physical training teacher is asked not to get involved in any issues by an astrologer. However, when a young girl is molested, he sets out to give her justice.
